## How did you test it?


## Checklist

- [ ] `go test ./...` passes and `gofmt -l .` prints nothing
- [ ] Web changes: `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass in `web/`
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed logic
- [ ] Matching page in `docs/` updated, and a line added to `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased"
- [ ] Changed a route, environment variable or setting? Ran `go run ./tools/docgen` and committed the result
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visible changes
- [ ] No API keys, passwords or personal data in code, logs, tests or screenshots
